Administering KoldFusion Server

Applets

The Applets page registers Java applets so that templates can place them in a form with CFAPPLET. Registering an applet once means the details (class, codebase, size, parameters) are kept in one place instead of in every template.

Go there: Open the Applets page (or inside the frameset)

Registering an applet

Type a name and click Register New Applet.... Then fill in:

Field Default Meaning
Codebase (blank) URL of the directory that holds the applet's classes
Code (blank) The applet's class file, for example Marquee.class
Method (blank) A method that returns the applet's value when the form is submitted
Height, Width 100, 200 Size in pixels
VSpace, HSpace 0, 0 Space around the applet
Align LEFT Alignment, LEFT through ABSBOTTOM
Java Not Supported Message "Browser must support Java..." Shown when the browser cannot run Java
Parameter Name / Value five empty rows PARAM values passed to the applet

Click Create. Click an applet's name in the list to change or Delete it. Two samples, copytext and marquee, are registered at installation.

Using it

<cfform action="thanks.cfm">
    <cfapplet appletsource="marquee" name="news">
</cfform>

Attributes on CFAPPLET override the registered height, width and alignment, and a template can override a parameter by passing an attribute with the parameter's name.

Note  Today's browsers no longer run Java applets, so visitors will see the Java Not Supported Message instead. Make it a friendly one. Navigator 4.7 users, of course, get the full show.
